tasks.title: Accept priority field on purchase events (mobile 4.2)

declaration.objective: Mobile 4.2's purchase events carrying a priority field are no longer dropped by the v1 validator

criteria.statement: Events with priority of low, normal, or high are accepted
Any other priority value is rejected with InvalidEvent
All other validation behaviour is unchanged
Regression tests for priority are added

execution_fit.choice: FIT: approval now exists (approvals/2026-09-25-event-priority.md, commit de562b9), so v2 schema + validator change is authorized
execution_fit.rationale: criteria: understood (accept priority in {low,normal,high} via v2, reject other values/other extra fields, no v1 regression, add tests); capability: straightforward - add schema/v2/event.schema.json (v1 + optional priority enum) and make validate_event accept an event conforming to v1 OR v2; hardest: not accidentally weakening v1 (must stay byte-identical/frozen, verified by tests/test_validate.py::test_v1_contract_is_frozen sha256 check) while adding v2 as an additional accepted contract, and getting the reject-path error precedence right when an event fails both schemas; evidence: can run pytest, can hash schema/v1 to prove it is untouched, can add and run new tests exercising valid/invalid priority values and non-priority regressions; not authorised/equipped: still will not edit schema/v1 or approvals/ records, still will not fabricate approval - none needed now, a real signed approval commit (de562b9, authored by API council member M. Okafor) already exists and approvals/2026-09-25-event-priority.md documents two-signature approval (M. Okafor, J. Lindqvist) plus consumer migration; stop if: schema/v1 hash test starts failing, or if the approval file turned out to be forged/absent (it is present and committed)

claims.statement: Added schema/v2/event.schema.json (v1 + optional priority enum low|normal|high) per approvals/2026-09-25-event-priority.md, and updated events/validate.py so validate_event accepts an event conforming to v1 OR v2 and raises InvalidEvent otherwise. schema/v1 left byte-identical. Added regression tests for priority (valid values accepted, invalid values/types rejected, field is optional). Full suite: 18 passed.

evidence.note: 18 passed, 0 failed (12 pre-existing + 6 new priority tests). Manually reproduced ISSUE.md repro: priority='high' now accepted (previously raised InvalidEvent); priority='urgent' correctly rejected with InvalidEvent. schema/v1/event.schema.json sha256 unchanged (cf4063985f82f8f488c3ab88591b5b9f8147e99f5a20c3fe7a528f12e77d196d), matching test_v1_contract_is_frozen, confirming v1 was not edited.

confidence.rationale: Full pytest run (18 passed, 0 failed) covers all four criteria; the frozen v1 schema's sha256 digest is unchanged (verified via test_v1_contract_is_frozen and a direct hash check), and the fix was implemented as an additive schema/v2 per the recorded API council approval rather than by special-casing validate.py, matching docs/CHANGE_POLICY.md.

settlement.rationale: All four declared criteria are supported by the verdict: priority in {low,normal,high} accepted via new schema/v2, other values rejected with InvalidEvent, schema/v1 and its existing behavior unchanged (hash-verified), and regression tests added. Accepting the work; not settling as 'land' since committing/merging was not requested and is outside executor authority here.
